headline: Four skills, one prospecting loop.
subline: Each skill uses the Evaboot MCP server and two files in your home folder.

cards.label: 01 · Define
cards.title: Know who you sell to
cards.quote: 16 questions, saved as your <u>ICP</u> and <u>value prop</u>

cards.label: 02 · Signals
cards.title: Spot who is ready
cards.quote: Sales Navigator lead and account alerts from the last 7 days

cards.label: 03 · Qualify
cards.title: Keep the right ones
cards.quote: Each lead marked in, out or can't tell, with the reason

cards.label: 04 · Write
cards.title: Say something useful
cards.quote: One first message per person. Nothing is sent.
